instruction: Look at guih19_pneumatic_schematic_seed.dxf in LibreCAD. Use the existing pneumatic blocks to complete the hard pneumatic schematic. Insert COMPRESSOR at (25,70), FRL at (85,70), VALVE_5_2 at (170,70), CYLINDER at (280,105), and SILENCER blocks at (170,35) and (205,35). Add PNEUM lines (37,70)-(67,70), (103,70)-(150,70), (190,77)-(258,105), (190,63)-(258,90), exhaust drops (170,60)-(170,43) and (205,60)-(205,43), PILOT lines (140,120)-(170,80) and (210,120)-(190,80), and labels AIR SUPPLY, FRL-1, VLV-1 5/2, CYL-1, and PNEUMATIC CIRCUIT P-04. Save the result as /home/user/Desktop/guih19_pneumatic_schematic_completed.dxf. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
